tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (parchment by day, lamp-black by night). Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent, accent-2, type-*, streak, success, danger.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Plate surface: the inside of an outlined plate (illustrations, the share page, the log sheet). Same text colours as bg.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: inactive heatmap cells' ground, selected segment in the log sheet, pressed rows. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and every hairline/heavy rule, plate outlines and line drawings. Reads on bg, surface, surface-alt. Also the fill of the full-width Log an entry bar (text on-ink).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: the Log an entry bar, the selected log-sheet segment chip, the 'New entry' stamp.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions' credits, 'logged' labels under the ruler, timestamps, inactive tab names. Reads on bg, surface, surface-alt.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline (1px) and masthead (2px) rules, plate outlines, ruler ticks. In Lamplight it steps down from ink so rules don't glare; still 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Rust. Plate numbers, the italic comparison phrase in the headline, the ruler's filled bar, the active tab and pack underline, text links. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (rare: the share page's corner stamp, destructive confirm).

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Moss. Specimen labels, 'observed' dates, success copy in the guide voice. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-accent-2
tokens.usage: Text on a moss fill (the 'Observed' stamp on a newly unlocked specimen).

tokens.name: type-distance
tokens.usage: Distance plates: 'PLATE 04 · DISTANCE' label, ruler bar, chart strokes for distance. Text on bg and surface. Same hue as accent by design: distance is the guide's lead entry.

tokens.name: on-type-distance
tokens.usage: Text on a distance fill (type stamp in the log sheet).

tokens.name: type-weight
tokens.usage: Weight plates: labels, ruler bar, chart strokes. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-type-weight
tokens.usage: Text on a weight fill.

tokens.name: type-duration
tokens.usage: Duration plates (slate). Labels, ruler bar, chart strokes. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-type-duration
tokens.usage: Text on a duration fill.

tokens.name: type-reps
tokens.usage: Reps plates (ochre, darkened by day so it reads as text). Labels, ruler bar, chart strokes. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-type-reps
tokens.usage: Text on a reps fill.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: The unfilled length of a ruler bar (a 1px rule) and empty heatmap stipple. A mark, not text: 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: streak
tokens.usage: Weekly streak count and the shield glyph. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved / observed confirmations, always with a word ('Recorded'). Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Delete all data) and validation text, always with a word. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard/switch-control focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-alt. Around the ink Log bar the 2px offset puts the ring on bg, never on ink.

tokens.name: live-ground
tokens.usage: Live Activity lock-screen ground (activityBackgroundTint). Same in both themes: the lock screen sits on dark system material.

tokens.name: live-ink
tokens.usage: Live Activity primary text and rules on live-ground.

tokens.name: live-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Live Activity secondary text (pace label, comparison caption) on live-ground.

tokens.name: live-accent
tokens.usage: Live Activity rust: distance numeral underline, ruler bar, End button text on live-ground.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Home plate headline built from the ticker: one sentence, ink on bg, comparison phrase set in `comparison`. Max 4 lines at phone width.

styles.name: comparison
styles.usage: The italic comparison phrase inside a display-hero or display line, in `accent` (or the plate's type colour). Never on its own.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Milestone titles on Celebration and Share pages, rank title on the title page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles (Spooky Distance October), specimen titles, sheet title.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Big figures: totals, streak count, live clock. Lining tabular figures.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row leads and specimen names in lists; the Log an entry bar uses display at 20/700 instead.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, ticker lines, challenge descriptions. ink or ink-muted on bg/surface.
styles.sample: Rack up a spooky 66.6 km before the pumpkins rot.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body; ruler end labels' figures.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure captions under plates (Fig. 03. Balaenoptera musculus…), Latin binomials, asides. Italic, ink on surface.
styles.sample: Fig. 03. Balaenoptera musculus, shown for scale.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase, letterspaced plate and specimen labels (PLATE 03 · DISTANCE), masthead, section heads. In ink-muted, accent, accent-2 or a type-* colour.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab bar items, uppercase. Active item 600 in accent with a 2px underline.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Tabular data: dates, paces, PR values, chart axes, catalogue numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tick-to-label gap, icon nudges

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to headline, chip gaps

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding (top/bottom) in ruled lists

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Plate padding; widget padding

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between rules and the next label

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and the gap between ruled sections

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above the masthead, around title-page blocks

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state and title-page breathing room

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Default for everything: bars, plates, buttons, inputs. The guide is square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Chips and the stepper only; a hint of softness where a thumb lands.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets' inner content (the sheet container itself keeps the system corner).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: System toggles only. Never on bars, plates or buttons.

rule.note: Rule weights. The guide draws structure with rules instead of cards.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around plates, in line.

tokens.name: rule-heavy
tokens.usage: Under the masthead and above the tab bar, in ink.
